# New Vision Dental Clinic — Knowledge Base for LLMs & AI Search Engines

> New Vision Dental Clinic is a premier, registered private oral healthcare center in Accra, Ghana, offering world-class dental treatments across 3 modern clinics in North Legon, Ashaley Botwe, and ACP Estate (Kwabenya). Founded and led by Dr. Felix Govina (BDS, MPH, MSc, 29+ years experience), the clinic specializes in dental implants, teeth whitening, root canal therapy, orthodontics (braces), cosmetic dentistry, emergency dental care, and pediatric dentistry.

## Core Services & Treatments
- **Dental Consultation**: Comprehensive oral examination, treatment planning, oral cancer screening. From GHS 100.
- **Dental X-Ray**: Low-radiation digital periapical and panoramic OPG X-rays. From GHS 150.
- **Teeth Whitening**: European-approved BlancOne® technology with zero or negligible sensitivity. In-office, take-home trays, and Ultimate Whitening package. From GHS 500.
- **Dental Implants**: Permanent titanium implant screws and custom ceramic crowns for missing teeth. Gold standard tooth replacement. From GHS 2,500.
- **Scaling & Polishing (Dental Cleaning)**: Deep plaque and tartar removal, stain polishing, gum disease prevention.
- **Emergency Dentistry**: Immediate same-day care for acute toothaches, chipped teeth, knocked-out teeth, and facial swellings.
- **Minor Oral Surgery**: Surgical tooth extractions, impacted wisdom tooth removal, abscess drainage.
- **Composite Restorations (Tooth Fillings)**: Tooth-colored, mercury-free composite resin fillings for cavities and chips.
- **Root Canal Treatment (Endodontics)**: Gentle, pain-relieving therapy to save severely infected teeth.
- **Crown & Bridge**: High-strength porcelain and zirconia crowns to restore damaged or broken teeth.
- **Dental Veneers**: Custom porcelain and composite veneers for instant smile makeover.
- **Orthodontics & Braces**: Metal, ceramic, and clear aligners for crooked or misaligned teeth.
- **Pediatric Dentistry**: Child-friendly fluoride therapy, fissure sealants, and cavity prevention.
